2403-5170-6132-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

443-1939-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-1939-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2586-3197-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat

132-3263-4687-5527.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-3263-4687-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
132-3263-4687-5527.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
132-3263-4687-5527.notes: This combo only produces infinite mana if you control at least four Clues.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3921-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3921-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Winding Constrictor.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

141-7202.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-7202.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
141-7202.description:
Cast Kindle the Inner Flame by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Kindle the Inner Flame, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Kindle the Inner Flame, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

582-1409-4365.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve the Brazen Freebooter trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1308-1409-5423.description:
Activate Swashbuckler Extraordinaire by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Swashbuckler Extraordinaire enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Swashbuckler Extraordinaire.
Resolve the Swashbuckler Extraordinaire trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2366-2800-5702-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-2800-5702-6968.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6199-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Marionette Apprentice.
When Marionette Apprentice dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Apprentice enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2511-3239-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

2661-3168-3692.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {U}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Resolve the first Aethersnipe trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Aethersnipe trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

500-851-2523-6663.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Adrix and Nev and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put either Adrix and Nev token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Adrix and Nevs dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Adrix and Nevs you control.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-3921.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-3921.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

4050-4871-6115.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {1}.
When Ozox dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jumblebones, adding {1}.
When Jumblebones dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Jumblebones trigger, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

804-5147-5756.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
When Sakashima the Impostor dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

56-3967-5695.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Repeat from step 3.

3542-4790.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {6}.
3542-4790.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {6}.
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If the up to seven lands can tap to produce at least {7}, this combo nets infinite mana.

527-1175-2544.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
527-1175-2544.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Patriar's Seal's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Selvala.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Patriar's Seal.
Repeat.
 If you control a creature with power 6 or greater, this combo nets infinite colored mana, and you may untap any artifact(s) you control.

819-1661-1980-5195.description:
Cast any spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Memory Lapse either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Swarm Intelligence and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, copying Memory Lapse, targeting the original Memory Lapse.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Memory Lapse, countering the original Memory Lapse and putting it on top of your library.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

2882-4112.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Sharuum.
You have a way to cause another artifact creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2882-4112.description:
Cause another artifact creature to enter the battlefield as a copy of Sharuum.
Put the copy of Sharuum into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The copy of Sharuum's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning an artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Sharuum.
